facts.fact: The Direction générale de la modernisation de l'état civil trained delegated officers and transcribing agents in Pouni on the VENEEM platform for real-time entry of births, marriages and deaths, funded by PREGOLS for 2026.
The same session covered real-time entry of deaths, alongside births and marriages, on VENEEM at central and secondary registration offices, per the Agence d'Information du Burkina.
